summary: Iteration 4 testing: LLM DNA extraction (Claude Sonnet 5), upload→recall integration, MongoDB persistence, Presentation Mode 8-step walkthrough. Backend 11/11 pass, Frontend all critical flows pass. LLM extractor confirmed active (extractor='anthropic:claude-sonnet-5', confidence 0.85), uploaded cases persist to Mongo and appear in /api/cases, /api/recall, and UI /recall similar experiences.

ui_bugs.issue: Hardcoded caption reads 'Rule-based extraction — review before trusting' even when the actual extractor is LLM (extractor='anthropic:claude-sonnet-5'). Misleading — should read the extractor field from extracted_dna and display LLM/regex accordingly.

action_items: (Optional/LOW) Fix hardcoded 'Rule-based extraction' caption in CaseUpload.jsx dna-result panel — display extractor-aware text (e.g., show extracted_dna.extractor value).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is 1138 lines — recommend splitting into modules (routes/, extractors/, hub/) for maintainability.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in FastAPI — recommend migrating to lifespan context manager.
UPLOADED_CASES global list combined with Mongo persistence is fine but not process-safe; multi-worker deployment could cause divergence. Consider always reading from Mongo.
LLM extraction has no timeout on stream_message — a hung LLM stream would block the upload request. Consider asyncio.wait_for with a bound.
extract_dna_from_text uses text[:8000] truncation — silent; consider surfacing 'truncated' flag in DNA output.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all Presentation Mode + Upload/Recall integration checks pass)

seed_data_creation: Test creates and cleans up ephemeral UPLOAD- cases via /api/uploads and DELETE /api/uploads/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_4.py covers LLM extraction, Mongo persistence, /api/cases integration, recall integration and DELETE. It requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY set (uses ~60s LLM call). Frontend Presentation Mode is stable — start-demo-btn navigates through 8 steps with proper URL query params (?demo=1&step=N), deep-linking works, outro modal + close/exit clean URL. Uploaded cases with UPLOAD- prefix are visible in /recall similarity radar and matches list.
